d: Donald Trump says the United States no longer needs a peace deal with Iran, as the fallout of the eight-month war continues to shape American politics and regional security. After the Republicans' sweeping midterm defeat, Trump has redirected Vice President JD Vance away from negotiations with Tehran. But Iran has laid down seven conditions for ending the conflict, including sanctions relief, the removal of the US naval blockade and guarantees over the Strait of Hormuz.
